{"command":"cat >> /work/tests/test_api.py << 'EOF'


def test_priority_create_and_reload(tmp_path):
    p = str(tmp_path / "s.json")
    s = Store(p)
    create_task(s, {"title": "a", "priority": "high"})
    create_task(s, {"title": "b"})
    s2 = Store(p)
    assert [t["priority"] for t in list_tasks(s2)] == ["high", "normal"]


def test_priority_validation_and_no_save(tmp_path):
    p = str(tmp_path / "s.json")
    s = Store(p)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        create_task(s, {"title": "a", "priority": "urgent"})
    assert s.tasks == {}
    t = create_task(s, {"title": "a"})
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        update_task(s, t["id"], {"priority": "urgent"})
    assert s.tasks[t["id"]].priority == "normal"


def test_legacy_store_loads_as_normal(tmp_path):
    import json
    p = str(tmp_path / "s.json")
    with open(p, "w") as f:
        json.dump({"version": 1, "tasks": [{"id": 1, "title": "old", "done": False}]}, f)
    s = Store(p)
    assert list_tasks(s)[0]["priority"] == "normal"


def test_filter_and_sort(tmp_path):
    s = Store(str(tmp_path / "s.json"))
    create_task(s, {"title": "low1", "priority": "low"})
    create_task(s, {"title": "high1", "priority": "high"})
    create_task(s, {"title": "normal1"})
    create_task(s, {"title": "high2", "priority": "high"})
    assert [t["title"] for t in list_tasks(s, priority="high")] == ["high1", "high2"]
    assert [t["title"] for t in list_tasks(s, sort="priority")] == ["high1", "high2", "normal1", "low1"]
    assert [t["title"] for t in list_tasks(s)] == ["low1", "high1", "normal1", "high2"]
EOF
python -m pytest -v"}
